subject: Coordination for sensitive reviews and manager action items
messages:
From: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acmehealth.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: hr-legal@acmehealth.io
Date: Fri, 1 May 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership coordination: upcoming performance reviews & org change

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the quick touch on this. Per our conversation — we have a short window to complete a set of sensitive performance conversations tied to the restructuring in Platform Ops. HR needs to coordinate with leadership to ensure consistency and mitigate risk (comp issues, potential attrition, and any accommodation requests).

Can you confirm:
- Which managers will be conducting the conversations (so HR can prep notes and join when requested)?
- Whether any conversations should be held with HR present (I flagged two in my notes as high risk).
- If there are any non-standard compensation/termination considerations that need legal review.

I attached a 1-page summary of engagement highlights our team collected (engagement_highlights_2026.pdf). Please DO NOT circulate the attachment beyond leadership and HR. We will provide a secure upload link for scorecards if you prefer.

Suggested timeline: initial manager sync by Tue 5/5, one-week window for conversations (5/6–5/13), final sign-off with HR by 5/15. Let me know conflicts.

Thanks,
Sara Thompson
HR Business Partner, Acme Health

Attachments: engagement_highlights_2026.pdf (PDF, 220KB)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acmehealth.io>
Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership coordination: upcoming performance reviews & org change

Thanks Sara — and copying leadership. We’ll treat the attachments and the details as HR-confidential. High level plan below; please confirm or flag edits by end of day Monday (5/4):

1) Managers running conversations: Laura (Platform SRE), Marcus (Platform Eng), Tessa (Infra Ops), Rishi (Platform PMs).
2) HR presence: Laura has two high-risk cases; HR to join Laura’s sessions. Marcus to request HR on a case-by-case basis.
3) Sensitive docs: I’ve attached a template for manager notes (sensitive_review_template.docx). Please keep all scorecards in the secure Drive folder I shared (link in calendar invite).
4) Timeline: manager sync on Thu 5/6 10:00–11:00 (I’ll send invite). Conversations 5/6–5/13. Final HR sign-off by 5/15.

Action items (owners):
- Laura: compile scorecards for your team and highlight 3 cases for HR presence (due 5/5 EOD).
- Marcus: prepare talking points for direct reports with borderline performance (draft due 5/5).
- Tessa: confirm availability for backup coverage during conversations (due 5/4).
- Rishi: anonymize survey quotes you plan to use and place in the secure Drive (done by 5/6).

I’ll follow up with a consolidated checklist after everyone confirms. If anything needs legal review, loop hr-legal@acmehealth.io.

— Vivek
VP, Platform & Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sensitive_review_template.docx (DOCX, 45KB)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acmehealth.io>, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership coordination: upcoming performance reviews & org change

Vivek — I’m on this. Quick updates:

- I have identified three people I’m categorizing as high risk for attrition post-change (names are in the secure sheet only). I want HR in the room for two of those.
- One individual has a pending accommodation request (medical) — I’ve flagged with People Ops and will share details directly with Sara and hr-legal.
- Compensation: there’s one borderline case where market adjustment is reasonable; I’ll send supporting comp data to HR for review — may need HR/legal approval before the conversation.

I’ll upload perf_scorecards.xlsx to the secure folder today and will use your template for notes.

Laura
Director, Platform SRE
Redwood Inference

Attachment: perf_scorecards.xlsx (XLSX, 320KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Manager talking points + availability

Folks — I drafted talking points to keep conversations consistent across teams (short, fact-based, avoid verbatim survey quotes). I uploaded manager_talking_points.md to the shared folder. Highlights:
- Start with appreciation and context for org change
- Review performance evidence (3 data points max)
- Avoid comparing employees to each other
- Offer next steps and timeline (30/60/90-day goals)

Availability: I can run practice role-plays Wed 5/6 2:00–3:00 or Thu 5/7 9:00–10:00. Sign up via the invite Vivek will send.

Marcus
Head of Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachment: manager_talking_points.md (MD, 6KB)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Cc: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acmehealth.io>
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership coordination: upcoming performance reviews & org change

Couple of notes from the product org side:

- Engagement survey contained several verbatim comments that are actionable but potentially identifying. I recommend we anonymize and summarize themes, and only share verbatim quotes with HR/legal clearance.
- Please provide a secure upload link for any raw survey exports — I won’t share copies in email. Sara, could you confirm the upload method?

Related: I added a short redline to the talking points recommending language for retention offers (if needed).

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acmehealth.io>, hr-legal@acmehealth.io
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership coordination: upcoming performance reviews & org change — final plan and owners

Thanks all for the quick turn. Final decisions and owners below (please treat this as CONFIDENTIAL):

Confirmed meetings:
- Manager sync (practice + checklist): Thu 5/6, 10:00–11:00 (recording off).
- Live conversations window: 5/6–5/13.

Owners and deliverables:
- Laura: upload scorecards and highlight the two (of three) high-risk cases that require HR present — deliverable completed (uploaded 5/3).
- Marcus: lead manager role-plays and finalize talking points (uploaded 5/5).
- Tessa: ensure coverage for ongoing support; please confirm backup schedules by EOD 5/4 (done).
- Rishi: anonymize survey quotes and upload to secure Drive (please confirm when completed).
- Sara/HR: will join the two flagged sessions and provide legal intake where needed.

Security/process notes:
- No sensitive attachments should be forwarded outside leadership + HR. Use the Drive folder above (access limited).
- If compensation exceptions are requested, include hr-legal in the thread before any offers are made.

Next immediate steps: I will send calendar invites and a short checklist to each manager. Once the conversations are complete, managers should submit the filled templates to HR for final sign-off by 5/15.

If anything changes, DM me directly. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

— Vivek
VP, Platform & Reliability
Redwood Inference
